name: CIG Raton Basin 2002 Expansion
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 pipeline projects workbook, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 269: CIG Raton Basin 2002 Expansion, Colorado Interstate Gas Co, Completed 15 December 2002, 53.97 miles, 16 and 20 inch, 47.3 MMcf/d added, cost 22.1 million dollars, FERC docket CP02-06. A Federal Register notice of 20 March 2002 (FERC amendment to the CP02-06 application) lists three loops: 22.10 miles and 24.20 miles of 16 inch on the existing Campo Lateral, and 7.67 miles of 20 inch on Line 3A (ending in Cimarron County, Oklahoma). These sum to 53.97 miles, matching EIA. The loops are on existing Colorado Interstate Gas lines. This is an expansion with its own row shape under the parent name; the only existing Colorado Interstate Gas row is P0168, a whole-system row with no segments, so it is not the same record. The 2001 expansion (CP00-452) and 2005 expansion (CP05-50) are separate EIA entries. Length is above the 25 km floor (about 86 km) and the project is built and in service. Start and end locations are approximate from the notice. Notice dates the filing in 2002, used as the proposal year. Owner is not staged: the current owner on P0168 is Kinder Morgan, but the 2002 owner was a prior parent and no ownership ref was found, so the owner is left to the operators tab. No route found; the loops follow existing CIG rights of way and no public geometry was located.
